subject: NORWEGIAN SEA.
text:
NORWEGIAN SEA.
TSS OFF TRAENA TO TSS OFF HALTEN WESTWARDS.
SEISMIC SURVEY IN PROGRESS BY M/V AMAZON CONQUEROR TOWING 12 X 10000 METRE LONG CABLES IN AREA BOUND BY 65-40.8N 005-19.7E, 65-42.2N 006-52.3E, 64-33.5N 006-04.8E, 64-32.7N 004-33.7E.
WIDE BERTH OF 3 MILES AHEAD AND ABEAM, 7 MILES ASTERN REQUESTED.
M/V AMBER G AND M/V OCEAN DEE IN ATTENDANCE.
